Name: AT - VR Cow
Author: MadLadArren
Description:
This is a small silly mod in reference to the VR Cow in real life that was supposed to "[i]boost[/i]" their milk output.
Includes baby cow and brown cow variants.

If you run into any issues (like textures not loading), feel free to DM me on Discord: arren7

[size=4][b]Requires[/b] [b]Alternative Textures[/b].[/size]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]How to use:[/size][/color][/b][size=4]
[list=1]
[*]Go to Robin's shop and buy the scissors
[*]Use the scissors on your cow (only vanilla cow would work)
[*]Select the texture or Arrent.AT.CowVR
[/list][/size]
